title: Work budget from polynomial bounds
statement: Fix $k,d,e\in\mathbb{N}$ and suppose there is a constant $C\in\mathbb{N}$ such that, for every $n,b\in\mathbb{N}$, both the uniform node random-example bound and the uniform node work bound at per-call failure parameter $2^{-(b+1)}/T_k$ are at most $C(n+1)^d(b+1)^e$, where $T_k$ is the junta-tree call count. Then, for every $n,b\in\mathbb{N}$, the total work budget at failure parameter $2^{-(b+1)}$ is at most $T_k C(n+1)^d(b+1)^e$.
